sections.html:
Policy Summary: This form supports MISH 58 governance of digital safety platforms and inspection workflows.

Procedure Capture: Record system of record used (Procore/Dashboard), checklist completion status, sync verification, and drone-flight controls when applicable.

Task Use: Complete after each digital inspection cycle and confirm end-of-shift sync.
